items.title: Europe, Canada leaders hold Yerevan talks in Trump's shadow
items.summary: European leaders and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney gather in Armenia Monday as they seek to navigate a fraught geopolitical environment under an unpredictable White House. US President Donald Trump will loom large over the meeting of the European Political Community (EPC).
